title: Long Island crash near Moriches Bay
place_text: Moriches Bay, Long Island, New York

tellings.quote: the the Long Island crash, I think it was supposed to be 1989 by Morish's Bay.

plain: Something is said to have crashed near Moriches Bay on Long Island, New York, in about 1989. The UFO historian Richard Dolan brings it up only briefly, without naming a source and unsure of the year ("I think it was supposed to be 1989"), as one more case of a craft said to have come down and been recovered.
